name: S-4V5
description: S-4V5 was a shopkeeper droid who worked as a starship components merchant during Great Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic. During the war it ran a stall within the Republic-controlled Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport on the planet Corellia. S-4V5 had yellow sensors and gold plating. While at its stall it made use of a holoprojector.
